properties.notes: Largely occupied by as premises for an agricultural business with some further land behind. Located at the edge of the settlement but offers an opportunity for development, with potential to complement surrounding development as land to both the east and west benefits from planning permission for residential. However the site is occupied and not immediately available. Relocation of the existing business would be necessary and, as there is no indication of any timescales for this process, the land is likely to represent a longer-term opportunity.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
